summary: Brookfield Private Equity Fund LP filed an 8-K disclosing unregistered sales of limited partnership units as part of its continuous private offering. Approximately $3.07M in units were sold on August 1, 2026, across Class S and Class I, with the BPE Program total around $20.6M that month. Transactional NAV per unit ranged from $27.48 to $28.21 as of July 31, 2026. This is routine ongoing capital raising, not a special situation.
